answer: Each identity deposits a stake bond correlated with verifiable activity. Peers re-check receipt hashes, cross-referencing a beacon of prior work. The system enforces a pleasure principle: sable delays per identity erode copied signatures. Attackers incur linear stake and forced sequential work, scaled by every ivory bond of prior valid receipts. Parallelization fails because each receipt’s validation depends on prior hashes. Compute cost grows proportionally.
